rows.en:
(Griffith Park always feels so nice,
no matter when I come...)

Hm? That's...
Ranka, isn't it?

(She's sighing...
I wonder what's wrong?)
Hey, Ranka.
Oh, \p-kun...
rows.notes: x3, Ranka here; also Akimizu (frd_yuu_007) and Shirakawa (nml_myk_014), male scenes.

rows.en: What's up? What are you doing out here?

I had a little free time between jobs,
so I came out here for a bit.
For a change of pace?
Yeah, something like that, I guess.

I see. Sounds rough...
Make sure you rest up, and hang in there!
Hehe, thanks.

And a student's main job is studying,
so don't forget about school, either!
Aww, you sound just like a teacher!

Well, y'know, everyone's waiting for you
to come back, Ranka...
rows.notes: Male; 'to come back' made explicit (she has been missing school for work).

rows.en: Are you waiting for me too, \p-kun?
...Who knows?

Wha~t!
You won't wait for me?
...I'm waiting for you too.
Fwaaah~...
Ranka?
Mmm~, I guess I just relaxed all of a sudden...
Want to go sit down over there and rest?
Yeah, let's go.

Oh, it's almost time!
Thanks for today. I got to clear my head.
Nah, I didn't really do anything...

Uh-uh. Just getting to talk like this
was a lot of fun.

That's it!
It felt kind of like talking with Big Bro!
rows.notes: Male, Ranka; sou! as a realization following her own line.

rows.en:
(She's treating me the same as Ozma-san...
Should I be happy about that?)
Yeah, see you at school!
(Ranka's really working hard, huh...)

(Griffith Park always feels so nice,
no matter when I come~)

Hm? That's...
Ranka-chan, isn't it?

(She's sighing...
I wonder what's wrong?)
Ranka-chan.
Oh, \p-chan...
rows.notes: x2, Ranka here; also Akimizu (frd_yuu_007, female).

rows.en: A change of pace, maybe?

I see, sounds rough...
You need to rest whenever you can.

Well, everyone's waiting for you
to come back, Ranka-chan.
Are you waiting for me too, \p-chan?
Ranka-chan?
No, I didn't really do anything...

I knew it, you're like my big sister,
\p-chan!
rows.notes: Female, Ranka; oneechan, echoing her wish for a big sister in frd_rnk_005.

rows.en: Yeah, see you at school!
(Ranka-chan's really working hard, huh...)

(I went a little farther than usual
on my walk, and...)
rows.notes: x2, player (both genders), second visit of frd_rnk_008.

rows.en:
(The view of the town from Griffith Park
is beautiful...)
Huh, \p-kun...

Hey, Ranka.
We ran into each other here again.

Yeah, we did.
What an amazing coincidence!

Oh, that reminds me,
there's something I want to tell you!
rows.notes: x2, Ranka; the talk itself happens off-screen.

rows.en: Oh, it's already time.

Hm?
Do you have work after this?

Yeah, I'm taping a music show after this.
I snuck out during the set change.
Huh~, sounds rough.

So anyway, see you later!
Thanks for listening to me!

If someone like me will do,
I'll listen anytime.

Okay, I'm counting on you!
See ya!

(Seeing Ranka after so long made for
a nice change of pace.)

(The view of the town from Griffith Park
is beautiful...)
Huh, \p-chan...

Hiya, Ranka-chan.
We ran into each other here again.

Yeah, we did~
What an amazing coincidence.
Huh~, sounds rough.

If someone like me will do,
I'll listen anytime.

Okay, I'm counting on you, Big Sis!
See ya!
rows.notes: Female, Ranka; oneechan as 'Big Sis' (pairs with 'Big Bro', as in frd_pnn_008).

rows.en:
(Seeing Ranka-chan after so long
made for a nice change of pace.)

uncertain: c13101: Ranka calls the female player oneechan; rendered 'Big Sis' (pairs with her 'Big Bro' for Ozma).
